latestVersion.changelog:
Video Editing for Beginners — Initial Release

- Launches simple, step-by-step cloud-based video editing aimed at beginners and students.
- Supports uploading raw video clips (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) for easy editing and export to 1080p MP4.
- Allows users to request editing actions (e.g. trim, transitions, text overlays) using natural language prompts.
- Handles authentication, session management, upload, editing, export, and credits via clear API workflows.
- Includes beginner-focused UX guidance and fast cloud rendering (export jobs typically complete in 1–2 minutes for short clips).
